notes: Customer must be fully deployed before ledger because the new ledger publishes payment.posted.amountMinor and no longer publishes amount. The new customer reader must accept both amountMinor and legacy amount so old ledger events remain readable during rollout and rollback. Deploy ledger instances one at a time after customer completes. If customer must be rolled back after ledger has switched, roll ledger back first or keep the new customer reader in place.
